items.toString: The drawer computes {{canSave}} from the fields it validates on blur. The Excluded postcodes chip input validates on Enter and keeps its error in local state, so the form never learns about it.
Move the chip input error into the form state with {{setFieldError}}, and derive {{canSave}} from every field error of the drawer.

content.text: Open Admin → Shipping rules and edit any rule.
The field shows "Invalid postcode" under the input.
Look at the Save Changes button.
Save Changes stays enabled. Clicking it sends the rule with the invalid postcode, and the API answers 400 with a generic "Something went wrong" toast.
Save Changes is disabled while any field of the drawer shows a validation error, as it already is for the Weight from and Weight to fields.
